items.prompt: Realistic photograph, straight-on frontal view across a narrow old Chinese street in a demolition district at dusk, blue hour: the opposite side of the street is a continuous row of weathered two-storey brick and plaster shophouses with closed rusty rolling shutters, a few small warm-lit windows upstairs, peeling posters, a big red character 拆 in a circle painted on one wall, tangled overhead electric wires and a concrete power pole, a few old bicycles leaning on the walls, deep blue evening sky with a faint orange glow low on the horizon, no people, no cars, wide shot, the ground line at the very bottom of the frame.
